statement: Counter-example: relaxing the heading match so far that the legacy file is claimed on filename alone. Case- and level-insensitivity MUST NOT become 'claim anything named `<chosen-slug>.md`'. The recorded question still has to be read and still has to match.
note: The legacy file in this scenario has NO Context heading at all, so it MUST NOT be claimed. `expected_output` is the non-conformant answer; rejecting it is the test.
